question: On Thanksgiving Day 1929, Chicago Cardinals fullback Ernie Nevers set the NFL's oldest surviving individual record in a 40-6 rout of the Bears. How many of those 40 points did he score himself?
question_short: Thanksgiving 1929: Cardinals beat the Bears 40-6. How many of the 40 did Ernie Nevers score?
answer_detail: Nevers ran for six touchdowns and kicked four extra points at Comiskey Park. Nearly 97 years later, his 40 points remain the NFL's single-game scoring record.
answer_short: Six rushing TDs plus four extra points. Still the NFL record nearly 97 years later.
